problems: Complement: 1/yr through 2019 entry, then 2 (2020, 2021, 2023, 2025) alternating with 1 (2022, 2024, 2026); complement_per_year given as the current max 2. Alumni graduation years differ between page versions: the 2023 version shifts 2012-2018 graduates by +1 (e.g. Boskovitz 2013); the 2018 and 2025 versions match the rosters and were used. Common Crawl not run: no year missing. tufts.edu prefix CDX query timed out (504); medicine.tufts.edu has only a department page, no roster. Live site blocks curl (Akamai 403); fetched with WebFetch. Phase 2: Europe PMC rate-limited once; uottawa.ca and mcmaster.ca domain CDX queries timed out (504), so narrower prefixes were used. The Tataryn bio (McMaster) and his papers (Ottawa) disagree on the destination; both are Canadian neurosurgery programs. A McMaster destination row was inserted in training_history with program_id NULL.
